comment: The maker's second line on the four pan CV inputs reads '5Vp-p bipolar CV for panning, sums with the pan knob'; the code divides the input by 2.5, so ±2.5V is the full sweep, which is 5V peak to peak as the maker says. The pan law is the maker's own, square-root times linear, giving about 1.5dB of centre attenuation. Chaining works only in one direction: a Hive passes its mix to the Hive on its right, and only when its own two outputs are unpatched (src/Hive.cpp:164-173). The chain shows itself as a menu label reading that the module is chained to the Hive on its left, which is a label rather than an item and so is not written as a menu line.
